label: S6_04_pnf
code_lines: SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM, (case when t1.C_SCN in ('P.51','P.52') then 'FBC' else 'Ahorro nac/ext' end) AS ID,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO
where t1.C_SCN in ('P.51','P.52', 'B.8','K.1') AND T1.C_CUENTA='Capital' AND T1.AÑO>2002
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM, 'TEST' AS ID,SUM(case when id<>'FBC' then T1.DATO else t1.dato*-1 end) AS DATO
proc sql; drop table FBC_AHORRO, delta;quit;
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM, 'PIB_ORIGEN' AS ID,SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM, 'PIB_GASTO' AS ID,SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_SCN='B.2' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO
where t1.C_SCN in ('P.32','P.4','P.51','P.52') OR (t1.C_SCN='B.2' AND SECTOR=6 AND T1.C_CUENTA='Producción')
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM, 'PIB_ING' AS ID,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO
where (t1.C_SCN in ('B.2/B.3','K.1','D.1') AND T1.SECTOR<>6 AND T1.C_CUENTA='Producción' AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D') OR (t1.C_SCN in ('D.21') AND T1.SECTOR<>6 AND T1.C_CUENTA='YG' AND T1.C_ENTRADA='H')
DATA PIB;SET ORIGEN GASTO INGRESO ORIGEN;RUN;
PROC SQL; UPDATE PIB SET DATO=DATO*-1 WHERE ID='PIB_GASTO';QUIT;
PROC SQL; UPDATE PIB SET DATO=DATO*-1 WHERE ID='PIB_ING';QUIT;
PROC SQL; UPDATE PIB SET ID='PIB_TEST';QUIT;
DATA PIB_TOTAL; SET ORIGEN GASTO INGRESO PIB;RUN;
PROC SQL; DROP TABLE PIB_TOTAL,ORIGEN, GASTO, INGRESO, PIB;QUIT;
PROC SQL;/*D8 sector financiero vs op. financiera hogares*/
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM,(CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR=511 THEN 'Hogares AF.612 CF' else 'FP D.8 CNF' END) AS ID,SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO
where (t1.C_SCN='D.8' AND T1.SECTOR IN (34,341,342)) OR (t1.C_SCN='AF.612' AND T1.SECTOR=511 AND T1.C_CUENTA='Financiera')
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM,'TEST D8 AF.612' AS ID,SUM(CASE WHEN ID='Hogares AF.612 CF' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM,'D.6 SF' AS ID,SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.DATO*-1 else T1.DATO END) AS DATO
where t1.C_SCN IN ('D.61','D.62') AND T1.SECTOR IN (34,341,342)
DATA D8; SET d8_of d8_of_t D6_SF;RUN;
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM,'TEST D8/D6 SF' AS ID,SUM(CASE WHEN T1.ID='D.6 SF' THEN T1.DATO*-1 else T1.DATO END) AS DATO
where t1.ID IN ('FP D.8 CNF','D.6 SF')
PROC SQL; DROP TABLE PIB_TOTAL,ORIGEN, GASTO, INGRESO, PIB;QUIT;
PROC SQL;DROP TABLE d8_of, d8_of_t, D6_SF,D8_D6;QUIT;
